prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / image edit. The current portrait is identity-authoritative. The already adopted knight and healer portraits are drawing-style references only. Optimize the supplied character as one coherent member of that same illustrated game roster.

Preserve species, gender, character identity, main color scheme, distinctive equipment, pose direction and full silhouette. Keep weapons, wings, tails and feet fully inside the portrait. Preserve the specific previous costume and gesture choices; do not transfer clothing, ornaments, species or poses from the references.

Rendering: refined 2D Japanese anime game illustration with controlled volume and clean cel-shaded forms. Clearly visible dark slightly thicker outer contours, medium structural overlap lines, fine sparse interior lines. Smooth intentional taper. Strong silhouette definition like the adopted references, without a uniform sticker stroke. Keep depth, appealing nuanced anime faces and a few meaningful material highlights; do not flatten into a generic cartoon or make a photorealistic / 3D render.

Humanoid anatomy: balanced adult proportions, natural head-to-shoulder and torso-to-leg relationship, readable hands, grounded stance; no tiny head, elongated thighs, pinched pelvis or distorted joints. Adult men have clean appealing East Asian anime features appropriate to their age and role, neither oily western realism nor effeminate identical faces. Nonhuman creatures remain nonhuman; machinery remains machinery.

Hair: organized large masses and a small number of clear locks, tidy silhouette, only a few purposeful loose strands. Cloth: broad continuous matte color areas, a few folds where tension, joints and gravity require them; no patchwork shadow blocks or dozens of decorative creases. White cloth stays white with restrained soft shadows. Armor: physically coherent plates, clear joins and limited grouped highlights; retain necessary signature ornament, remove invented gratuitous metal flourishes, micro-engraving, sparkling bits and layered filigree. Do not convert cloth into metal. Creature surfaces and mechanical parts follow the same line hierarchy and coherent restrained shading while keeping required anatomy and functional structure.

Background: opaque low-saturation softly graded color field matched to the character palette. Mid-dark overall, gently lighter behind the head and upper body, deeper near edges and lower corners, restrained foot contact shadow. Choose a subtle gray undertone that separates character colors: slate blue-gray, smoky gray-violet, muted sage-gray or warm charcoal/taupe. Uniform collection treatment, quiet broad forms. No scenery, architecture, foliage, clouds, smoke, particles, symbolic backdrop, magic circles, text, watermark, border, bokeh, grain, noise or photographic lighting. Existing character-specific weapon energy may remain, but no added environment effects or new rim lighting.

Portrait composition 2:3, target 1024x1536. One character only. Retain enough breathing room around signature silhouette and weapons. The supplied unit is the content; references provide only drawing quality and background treatment.

Input images: Image 1 editable character content; Image 2 only drawing style reference. Preserve this muscular bipedal reptilian war-chief: sage-teal scale hide with pale gray-green throat and abdomen, snarling long dragon snout, red eyes, large black crescent horns and black spines with red patches, big clawed arms and feet, curling armored tail behind viewer left. Existing outfit only: burgundy broad waist drapery with gold hem, a few gold ring fasteners, simple wrist and ankle gold bands with ruby centerpiece. Do not add chest armor, cape, sword, human hair or human face. Keep heavy powerful proportions and 3/4 stance toward viewer right; not a slender humanoid. Make scales coherent organic plates with simplified grouped shadows rather than mottled thousands of shiny specks; clear dark outer and overlap lines on snout, horns, hands, cloth and claws. Burgundy drape has large continuous matte planes and only gravity folds. Preserve necessary gold jewelry, no extra ornament. Background quietly graded desaturated slate blue-gray, slightly lighter behind head/shoulders, dark edges. Entire horn and tail tips plus both feet and hands in 2:3 portrait.

Finishing pass:
Use case: style-transfer finishing edit. Image1 sage-teal reptilian war chief is exact character identity, anatomy, costume, pose and palette authority. Image2 adopted healer is line hierarchy and restrained material reference only. The current outline is too fine. Substantially strengthen outer silhouette to deep near-black smoothly tapered ink about3–5px at1024width, especially horns, shoulders, clawed hands, tail curve, drapery edge and feet. Medium lines define body overlaps, fine sparse interior scale boundaries. Keep varied line weight, not uniform thick stickerstroke.
Repaint sage-green scaled flesh into coherent broad matte2D cel-shaded light/shadow masses. Neighboring scales share illumination; leave necessary organic scale boundary pattern but remove disconnected tiny shiny polygon patches and random pale dapples. Pale belly and thigh muscles have broad smooth volumes. Black horn/spine surfaces have one restrained highlight each, no mirrored shards. Burgundy waist cloth has broad continuous soft matte planes with3–4 required gravity folds total, no many angular creases. Keep current necessary gold fasteners, original wrists/ankles ruby bands; no new ornament.
Preserve snarling nonhuman dragon face and red eyes, existing black/red horns/spines, two arms/two powerful digitigrade legs and tail, exact gesture and original costume. No humanization, new armor, cape or sword. Same slateblue-gray graded background, subtle contact shadow. Full horns, hands, tail and all talons inside2:3frame. Rich anime-game volume and clean crisp contours rather than shiny3D.
visual_notes: Preserves sage-teal nonhuman war-chief, black/red horns and spikes, red eyes, burgundy waist cloth, existing ruby-gold bands and tail.
Finishing pass substantially increases dark external line and joins neighboring scale shading into coherent matte masses; reduces disconnected pale dapples.
Cloth remains broad matte planes. Full horns, tail, hands and talons inside frame with slate-blue-gray backdrop.
